skill.name: Speechall command-line tool for fast speech-to-text transcription using multiple providers

instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.

Install and use the speechall CLI tool for speech-to-text transcription. Use when the user wants to: (1) transcribe audio or video files to text, (2) install speechall on macOS or Linux, (3) list available STT models and their capabilities.
